verdict: RocketReach is a strong contact-data buy with clear Essentials/Pro/Ultimate pricing, but a weak CRM pipeline substitute. This review uses first-party pricing catalogue evidence — not hands-on testing.
strengths: Large professional contact graph with email + phone (Pro+)
Sequences, AI writer, and Autopilot automations
Pro+ CRM/SEP connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, etc.)
weaknesses: Export caps constrain 'unlimited' annual lookup marketing
Monthly plans tighten lookup ceilings sharply
Team pricing less transparent than individual cards
bestFor: Individual sellers and recruiters needing emails/phones
Teams wanting published prices vs quote-only databases
Outbound users who can land on Pro for phones + integrations
notIdealFor: Buyers needing a deal pipeline CRM
Teams that only need email and refuse export caps
Enterprises requiring fully custom data contracts only
tradeoffs: Transparent pricing vs deeper enterprise data platforms
Annual unlimited lookups vs hard export ceilings
Contact data breadth vs CRM workflow depth
recommendation: Choose RocketReach for published-price contact lookup. Budget Pro when phones and CRM sync matter; treat it as a data layer beside your CRM.
editorialNotes: Approved from official pricing page + first-party product API. handsOnTesting=false.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Individual pricing cards and lookup/export workflows are straightforward for prospectors; SPA UX is search-first rather than CRM-admin heavy.
RocketReach is a contact database, not a deal pipeline CRM.
Sequences and Autopilot are in the feature matrix; job limits rise on higher plans.
Email sending limits and sequences are documented; Essentials lacks phone channel data.
Operational/export limits dominate; not a sales forecasting CRM.
Lists, CSV enrich, and Ultimate Salesforce custom mapping offer moderate flexibility.
Pro+ includes Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft, Bullhorn, Zapier.
Individual plans are light; team/SSO complexity appears mainly on Ultimate/team paths.
Ultimate exports/API/SSO help; team plans exist but are custom.
Published Essentials/Pro/Ultimate USD ladder is clearer than Lusha’s Cloudflare-blocked public list in this research pass.

overallScoreRationale: Equal-weight CRM methodology average. Value/integrations help; pipeline-management is near-floor because this is not a CRM.
